poll_interval.description: How often to poll provider batch endpoints (Go duration).

default_max_tokens.description: Default max_tokens applied to batched requests that omit one.

providers.description: Per-provider credential block; mirrors the dedicated provider plugins.

api.description: Which OpenAI API batch lines are addressed to when no core.models entry declares one. Defaults to responses, matching nexus.llm.openai.

reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration for batched OpenAI requests. Reaches the wire on api: responses only. A core.models entry's own reasoning block merges over this one.

anthropic_api_key_env.description: Flat alias: env var holding the Anthropic API key.

openai_api_key_env.description: Flat alias: env var holding the OpenAI API key.
